findings.standard: AGENTS.md test-harness evidence integrity: failures must report exact diagnostic details and distinguish failure causes.
findings.finding: nativeSwitchAction returns the same .fail case for an unreadable nil switch value and for a second-attempt exhaustion. The caller labels both cases as a missing Settings control and captures the missing-control screenshot, so an existing but unreadable switch is misreported.
findings.recommendation: Use distinct unreadable and retry-exhausted outcomes. Keep the existing-control screenshot and include the nil value in the failure message for the unreadable case.
